sentences.en: The podcast 20,000 Hertz is a show about the world's most interesting and recognizable sounds.
sentences.zh: 播客《20,000赫兹》（20,000 Hertz）是一档关于世界上最有趣、最易辨识的声音的节目。

sentences.en: I think of it as almost a sibling of 99% invisible, lovingly produced and reported deep dives into everyday things that make you see the world differently.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它几乎是《99%无形》（99% Invisible）的姊妹篇，通过精心制作和深度报道，带你深入了解日常生活中的事物，让你以全新的视角看待世界。

sentences.en: Or in the case of 20,000 Hertz, make you hear the world differently.
sentences.zh: 或者就《20,000赫兹》而言，是让你以全新的方式聆听世界。

sentences.en: We've collaborated a number of times over the years, but we're featuring them today because our sibling podcast produced an episode with my actual sibling, Lee Mars,
sentences.zh: 多年来我们合作过多次，但今天我们要特别介绍他们，因为我们的姊妹播客制作了一期节目，嘉宾正是我的亲兄弟李·马尔斯（Lee Mars），

sentences.en: co-author of the book, Golden, The Power of Silence in a World of Noise.
sentences.zh: 他也是《黄金：喧嚣世界中的静默力量》（Golden, The Power of Silence in a World of Noise）一书的合著者。

sentences.en: Lee showed up on a mini-story episode of 99PI a few months back, talking about the ever-increasing loudness of sirens as a way of measuring how loud our world has become.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，李曾在《99%无形》的一个短篇故事中露面，谈论警笛声如何变得越来越响，以此作为衡量我们世界变得多么嘈杂的一种方式。

sentences.en: But the story 20,000 Hertz produced tackles the main thesis of Golden, Moore, head-on.
sentences.zh: 但《20,000赫兹》制作的这期故事，直接切入了《黄金》一书的核心论点。

sentences.en: I love how it turned out.
And I'm so proud of everyone involved that I just wanted to share it with you as a bonus episode.
sentences.zh: 我为所有参与其中的人感到骄傲，所以我想把它作为一期特别节目分享给你们。

sentences.en: It's an honor to be here with you all.
sentences.zh: 能在这里与大家相聚，我深感荣幸。
那是赛勒斯·哈比卜（Cyrus Habib）。

sentences.en: First, I want to just briefly tell you kind of what my job is, what my role is.
sentences.zh: 首先，我想简要介绍一下我的工作，也就是我的职责。

sentences.en: It's fall 2019, and Cyrus is giving a speech to a large crowd in a busy convention center.
sentences.zh: 那是2019年秋天，赛勒斯正在一个繁忙的会议中心向一大群人发表演讲。

sentences.en: He's wearing a black suit and dark sunglasses.
sentences.zh: 他穿着黑色西装，戴着深色墨镜。

sentences.en: Most people here in Washington State are too polite to ask the question, what do you actually do?
sentences.zh: 华盛顿州的大多数人因为礼貌，都不会问这个问题：你到底是做什么的？

sentences.en: For the last two years, Cyrus has been the lieutenant governor of Washington State.
sentences.zh: 在过去两年里，赛勒斯一直担任华盛顿州的副州长。

sentences.en: That means he's the second in command of the state's political system.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他是该州政治体系中的二号人物。

sentences.en: I serve as number two in the executive branch.
sentences.zh: 我在行政部门担任二把手。

sentences.en: As he talks, he grips a microphone in one hand and gestures to the crowd with the other.
sentences.zh: 他一边说话，一只手紧握麦克风，另一只手向人群挥舞示意。

sentences.en: He looks confident, like the successful politician that he is.
sentences.zh: 他看起来自信满满，就像他所展现出的那位成功的政治家一样。

sentences.en: If things worked out for you this year, if your business did well, your family's doing well, I'll take the credit for that.
sentences.zh: 如果今年你们一切顺利，如果你们的生意做得好，家庭生活美满，那我会把功劳归于自己。

sentences.en: People are predicting big things for his career.
sentences.zh: 人们都在预测他的职业生涯会有大作为。

sentences.en: They're already talking about him as a possible candidate for the next governor, even though he's still in his 30s.
sentences.zh: 尽管他才30多岁，人们已经开始谈论他作为下一任州长的潜在候选人了。

sentences.en: I'm for making sure that we give everyone the best opportunity.
sentences.zh: 我致力于确保我们给予每个人最好的机会。

sentences.en: Not any opportunity, but the best opportunity.
sentences.zh: 不是任何机会，而是最好的机会。

sentences.en: But Cyrus won't become governor, because not long after this speech, he announces that he's giving up politics entirely.
sentences.zh: 但赛勒斯不会成为州长，因为在那次演讲后不久，他宣布彻底放弃政治生涯。

sentences.en: That he's becoming a Jesuit novice and taking a temporary vow of silence.
sentences.zh: 他决定成为一名耶稣会见习修士，并许下暂时的静默誓言。

sentences.en: And that he will now pursue a life of poverty, chastity, and obedience.
sentences.zh: 他将从此追求贫穷、贞洁和服从的生活。

sentences.en: My office in a few different ways.
sentences.zh: 我的办公室以几种不同的方式。

sentences.en: First of all, we've been issuing a program, which is the first of its kind.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们一直在推行一个项目，这在当时是首创。

sentences.en: As I think back on my life, I was obsessed with the voice of the future calling back to me, telling me, you've got to do this, you've got to do this,
sentences.zh: 每当我回首往事，我曾痴迷于未来对我的召唤，它告诉我：你必须做这个，你必须做那个，

sentences.en: so that you can get to this other place.
sentences.zh: 这样你才能到达另一个地方。

sentences.en: Cyrus' parents immigrated to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 赛勒斯的父母从伊朗移民到美国。
在成长过程中，他一直决心要获得成功。

sentences.en: And growing up, he was always determined to succeed.
sentences.zh: 也许这与我童年时因癌症失明、变得双目失明，并形成了一种渴望被视为成功者的强迫性需求有关。

sentences.en: Perhaps this has to do with losing my eyesight to cancer as a child, becoming blind, and forming a kind of compulsive need to be seen as successful.
sentences.zh: 那种成功的渴望一直延续到他的政治生涯中。

sentences.en: That urge to succeed continued into his political career.
sentences.zh: 首先，他在州众议院任职，随后进入州参议院。

sentences.en: First, he served in the state House of Representatives, and then the state Senate.
sentences.zh: 能和这么多人在一起，让我感到振奋。

sentences.en: It was exhilarating for me to be around a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 能对庞大的观众发表演讲，让我感到振奋。

sentences.en: It was exhilarating for me to speak to huge audiences.
sentences.zh: 当我们在立法机构举行游说日，有成千上万的人到来时，我感到非常振奋。

sentences.en: It was exhilarating for me when we would have lobby days at the legislature, and you'd have thousands of people coming by.
sentences.zh: 赛勒斯的政治前途看起来一片光明。

sentences.en: Cyrus' political future looked really bright.
sentences.zh: 我取得了越来越多的成功。

sentences.en: I was achieving more and more success.
sentences.zh: 我收集了各种各样的荣誉和成就。

sentences.en: I had collected all kinds of accolades and achievements.
sentences.zh: 但尽管拥有了这一切成就，他从未感到满足。

sentences.en: But despite all of these achievements, he never felt satisfied.
sentences.zh: 随着这些事情的发生，我感到一种越来越强烈的空虚感。

sentences.en: As those things were happening, I felt a greater and greater sense of emptiness.
sentences.zh: 每当我获得一样东西，对下一件事的渴望就会更快地到来。

sentences.en: Each time I would obtain one, the desire would come even more quickly for the next thing.
sentences.zh: 最糟糕的是，他脑海中的声音总是让他不得安宁。

sentences.en: Worst of all, the voices in his head just wouldn't let him be.
sentences.zh: 也许是过去的声音，你知道，有人暗示因为我失明，有些事我做不到，我需要证明他们错了。

sentences.en: Maybe voices of the past, you know, people suggesting that there's things I can't do because I'm blind, and I need to prove them wrong.
sentences.zh: 也许是未来的声音，说：当你达到下一个阶段时，你会喜欢的。

sentences.en: Maybe voices from the future saying, you're going to love it when you reach this next stage.
sentences.zh: 也许是现在他人的声音，说：赛勒斯，你真的应该考虑做这个。

sentences.en: Maybe voices of others in the present saying, Cyrus, you really ought to think about doing this.
sentences.zh: 赛勒斯，你正是我们国家所需要的。

sentences.en: Cyrus, you're what our country needs.
sentences.zh: 这些声音，有些是虚构的，有些是真实的，它们挤占了我自己内心的渴望。

sentences.en: These are the kinds of voices, some fictional, some real, that had crowded out my own desires.

sentences.zh: 我自己的渴望其实与所有这些事情毫无关系。

sentences.en: My own desires actually had nothing to do with any of those things.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这个问题，有些人可能会尝试找一份新工作。

sentences.en: To fix this, some people might try looking for a new job.
sentences.zh: 其他人可能会开始锻炼或花更多时间陪伴家人。

sentences.en: Others might start exercising or spending more time with their family.
sentences.zh: 但赛勒斯有一个不同的想法。

sentences.en: But Cyrus had a different idea.
sentences.zh: 我读过詹姆斯·马丁（James Martin）的书《耶稣会士几乎一切指南》（The Jesuit Guide to Almost Everything），他在书中谈到了自己作为耶稣会士的生活。

sentences.en: I had read James Martin's book, The Jesuit Guide to Almost Everything, in which he talks about his life as a Jesuit.
sentences.zh: 这在我心中种下了一颗对这种生活的兴趣种子。

sentences.en: And so that had kind of planted a seed in me of interest in this life.
sentences.zh: 生活在宗教修会中会是什么样子？

sentences.en: What would it be like to live in a religious order?
sentences.zh: 许下誓言并极大地简化我的生活会是什么样子？

sentences.en: What would it be like to take vows and to simplify my life drastically?
sentences.zh: 过一种致力于服务他人的生活会是什么样子？

sentences.en: What would it be like to live a life dedicated to serving others?
sentences.zh: 在担任副州长期间，赛勒斯决定去参观一个耶稣会事工机构。

sentences.en: While he was still lieutenant governor, Cyrus decided to visit a Jesuit ministry.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，耶稣会士不是僧侣。

sentences.en: I mean, Jesuits are not monks.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，每天的生活还是有秩序和结构的。

sentences.en: But still, there's an order and a structure to the day.

sentences.zh: 早上7点到7点45分，独自冥想。
8点半，洗碗槽时间，也就是说，你要清洗锅碗瓢盆和餐具等等。
整天的时间都像这样安排好了，一直到睡觉前。

sentences.en: 8.30, scullery, which is to say, you know, cleaning the pots and pans and the dishes and everything.
sentences.zh: 我们被引导去希望并努力……

sentences.en: The whole day is planned out like this, right up until bedtime.
sentences.zh: 然后是在礼拜堂进行晚祷。
以及在深夜进行的任何其他祈祷。

sentences.en: We are brought to wish and endeavor to...
sentences.zh: 把这与政治家的生活做个比较。

sentences.en: And then night prayer in chapel.
sentences.zh: 公共生活，你知道，那是属于人群的生活。

sentences.en: And then whatever other prayer one does at the end of the night.
Compare that to the life of a politician.
sentences.zh: 通常我的办公室里会同时进行多场会议，我会在不同的群体之间穿梭，因为我们预约了太多人。

sentences.en: Public life, you know, it is the life of the crowd.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是他的工作生活。
即使在车里，我也会打开播客。

sentences.en: Often there'd be multiple meetings going on in my office and I would be kind of shuttling back and forth from different groups because we had so many people booked.
sentences.zh: 现在回想起来，我想，我确实试图把每一分每一秒的输入都塞进我的生活，即使是在本可以休息的时刻，一直到我睡着为止。

sentences.en: And it wasn't just his work life.
sentences.zh: 现年30岁的他现在是一位全国性人物。

sentences.en: Even in the car, I would turn on podcasts.
And now I look back and I think, I did try to squeeze every bit of input into my life, even in moments that could have been downtime, all the way till I fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 经过深思熟虑，赛勒斯做出了决定。

sentences.en: Currently 30 is now this national figure.
sentences.zh: 他完成了任期，然后卖掉了公寓。
他放弃了财产，离开去开启他作为耶稣会士的新生活。

sentences.en: After a lot of thought, Cyrus made his decision.
sentences.zh: 当人们告诉我：赛勒斯，听到你抛弃政治、事业和一切去成为一名耶稣会士，我感到非常惊讶和震惊。

sentences.en: He finished his term in office, then sold his apartment.
sentences.zh: 我说：好吧，如果你感到惊讶，那你觉得我感觉如何？

sentences.en: He gave up his possessions and left to begin his new life as a Jesuit.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，真的，连我自己现在都还感到惊讶。

sentences.en: When people tell me, I'm so surprised, I'm so shocked, Cyrus, to hear that you left politics behind and this career and everything to become a Jesuit.
sentences.zh: 赛勒斯做出了任何人能想象到的最令人惊讶的职业决定。

sentences.en: And I say, well, if you're surprised, how do you think I feel?
sentences.zh: 那是政策顾问兼政治策略师贾斯汀·佐恩（Justin Zorn）。

sentences.en: I mean, truly, I am still surprised.
sentences.zh: 他宣布自己将作为一名见习耶稣会士，许下贫穷、贞洁和服从的誓言。

sentences.en: Cyrus made the most surprising career decision anyone could possibly imagine.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的弗兰克·布鲁尼（Frank Bruni）将其描述为：

sentences.en: That's policy advisor and political strategist Justin Zorn.
sentences.zh: 政治家挥锤砸碎自己的自我。

sentences.en: He made an announcement that he was taking a vow of poverty, chastity, and obedience as a novice Jesuit prieSt.
sentences.zh: 在整个职业生涯中，贾斯汀参与过各种各样的项目。

sentences.en: And in the New York Times, Frank Bruni described it as,
sentences.zh: 环境正义、经济正义、气候、外交政策。

sentences.en: politician takes sledgehammer to own ego.
Throughout his career, Justin's worked on all kinds of projects.
Environmental justice, economic justice, climate, foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 有一些国会议员确实有必要找到一种慢下来的方法，

sentences.en: And I'm also a meditation teacher.
sentences.zh: 去关注呼吸，去关注心灵的运作，以及如何管理生活和政治中的神经症、强度和噪音。

sentences.en: I taught meditation on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 和赛勒斯一样，贾斯汀发现那种噪音让人精疲力竭。

sentences.en: There were a few members of Congress who had a real just necessity to find a way to slow down,
sentences.zh: 你知道，办公室里总是播放着有线电视新闻。

sentences.en: to tune into the breath, to tune into the workings of the mind and how to manage the neurosis and the intensity and the noise of life and politics.
Like Cyrus, Justin finds that noise to be pretty exhausting.
You know, cable news constantly running in the office.
sentences.zh: 然后要为你的选择负责。
这是一场永不停歇的游行，充满了会议、巡视、电话、谈判、筹款会议和电子邮件，以及你在听觉层面和信息层面的噪音中能想象到的所有要求。
最终，贾斯汀决定把那些噪音抛在脑后。

sentences.en: And then be responsible for your choice.
sentences.zh: 我和妻子离开了华盛顿特区，前往美国西部山区。

sentences.en: It's a non-stop parade of meetings and tours and phone calls and negotiations and fundraising sessions and emails and every requirement you can imagine at the auditory level of the noise and also the informational level of the noise.
sentences.zh: 当时我正处于职业转型的过程中。

sentences.en: Eventually, Justin decided to leave that noise behind.
sentences.zh: 大约在那个时候，他开始与一位名叫李·马尔斯的作家兼领导力教练合作。

sentences.en: My wife and I left D.C.
sentences.zh: 李对许多与贾斯汀相同的想法很感兴趣，两人开始合作写一本书。

sentences.en: and we headed out to the mountains in the western U.S.
sentences.zh: 那本书叫《黄金：喧嚣世界中的静默力量》。

sentences.en: And I was in the midst of a career transition.
sentences.zh: 所以我们决定顺藤摸瓜，开始采访神经科学家、诗人和活动家。

sentences.en: Around that time, he started collaborating with an author and leadership coach named Lee Mars.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到的问题是：你所经历过的最深沉的静默是什么？

sentences.en: Lee was interested in many of the same ideas as Justin, and the two of them started working on a book.
sentences.zh: 这个问题把贾斯汀引向了赛勒斯。

sentences.en: That book is called Golden, The Power of Silence in a World of Noise.
sentences.zh: 我的这位朋友说：天哪，你一定要见见这个人。

sentences.en: So we decided to just follow the cookie crumbs and started interviewing people, neuroscientists and poets and activists.
sentences.zh: 你们俩就像是在政治和精神生活的同一个交汇点上。

sentences.en: And the question we came upon was, what's the deepest silence you've ever known?
sentences.zh: 所以我请朋友帮我们牵线，他照做了，我们进行了第一次电话交谈。

sentences.en: That question led Justin to Cyrus.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀想知道的第一件事就是这个。

sentences.en: This friend of mine had said, oh my God, you've got to meet this guy.
sentences.zh: 从一种被噪音定义的生活转变为一种充满静默和反思的生活，是什么感觉？

sentences.en: You guys are just like at the same intersection of politics and spiritual life.
So I asked my friend to connect us, he did, and we had our first conversation by phone.
sentences.zh: 你不能用社交媒体，不能上网，不能和任何人通电话。

sentences.en: The first thing Justin wanted to know was this.
sentences.zh: 放下脑海中那些声音也很难。

sentences.en: What was it like going from a life that is defined by noise to one of silence and reflection?

sentences.zh: 我在做什么呢，你知道吗？

sentences.en: You're not on social media, you're not on the internet, you're not on the phone with anybody.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我现在本可以制定法律的。

sentences.en: It was also hard to let go of those voices in his head.
sentences.zh: 我本可以向媒体谈论一些新的想法或倡议。

sentences.en: What am I doing, you know?
I mean, I could be making laws right now.
sentences.zh: 这些声音在告诉赛勒斯，他应该回到原来的生活中去。

sentences.en: I could be speaking to the media about some new idea or initiative.
sentences.zh: 那是一种围绕着让尽可能多的人听到他的想法而建立的生活。
从某种程度上说，这并不奇怪。
因为现代社会的一切都是关于制造噪音和博取关注。

sentences.en: These voices were telling Cyrus that he should go back to his old life.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看我们整个社会现在的结构方式，

sentences.en: A life that was built around getting his ideas heard by as many people as possible.
sentences.zh: 甚至是我们衡量经济、衡量进步的方式，

sentences.en: In a way, it's not surprising.
sentences.zh: 我们衡量进步的首要标准也是为了最大限度地生产

sentences.en: Because modern society is all about making noise and getting attention.
If you look at the way our whole society is structured right now,
sentences.zh: 但对赛勒斯来说，最艰难的部分还在后面。

sentences.en: even how we measure the economy, how we measure progress,
sentences.zh: 因为作为一名耶稣会见习修士，他必须经历整整一个月不说话。

sentences.en: our foremost measure of progress is also primed for the maximum production
sentences.zh: 因为作为一个耶稣会初修士，他必须度过整整一个月不说话的日子

sentences.en: of mental stuff, of sound and stimulus.
But for Cyrus, the hardest part was still ahead.
Because as a Jesuit novice, he had to go through an entire month without speaking
He couldn't even write an email or send a text.
sentences.zh: 他甚至无法写邮件或发短信。

sentences.en: The first few days were pretty hard.
Just because you're not used to silence.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是因为你不习惯安静。

sentences.en: And, you know, after a couple days, you think,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，过了几天，你会想，

sentences.en: Oh my God, it's been so long.
sentences.zh: 天哪，已经过去这么久了。

sentences.en: And then you realize, Oh my God, there are 28 more days of this.
sentences.zh: 然后你意识到，天哪，还有28天要熬。

sentences.en: A vow of silence is supposed to help you discover spiritual truths.
sentences.zh: 禁语修行本应帮助你发现精神真理。

sentences.en: But when you experience something profound, it's natural to want to talk about it.
